name: Cecilia Chao
source:
A student from China and a classmate of the protagonist and Mutsumi. She is Mutsumi's best friend.
She's not exactly shy, but she's the type who's reserved around strangers.
Before becoming friends with Mutsumi, she lived lonely days, unfamiliar with both Japan and the school.
Because of her dignified expression, well-defined features, and magnificent body line, she's quite popular with boys, but perhaps because of her demeanor, it's difficult for them to approach her.
The only guy she can talk to casually is the protagonist.

She is a member of the rhythmic gymnastics club and was once in an acrobatics troupe, and she is proud of her flexibility.
She can handle any seductive style.
At heart, she is a serious person, always taking everything with utmost sincerity. Contrary to her cool appearance, she actively participates in even the most intense sex training sessions.
Aiming to master acrobatic and glamorous dances that make the most of her body's flexibility!?

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101121054620/http://www.cellworks.co.jp/curious/pink/pink_character.htm]official website[/url]]
